# NightWatch Gradle wrapper scripts (skeleton)
#
# These scripts are normally generated by `gradle wrapper` and are committed
# to the repository. They are intentionally not hand-written here.
#
# TO GENERATE:
#   1. Install Gradle 8.7 locally (or use Android Studio's bundled Gradle).
#   2. Run:  gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.7
#   3. Commit the generated `gradlew`, `gradlew.bat`, and
#      `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar`.
#
# The pinned version lives in `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties`.
